scripts:
create group rbc-dam-authors
create group rbc-dam-reviewers
create group rbc-dam-admins
add rbc-dam-authors to group dam-users
add rbc-dam-reviewers to group dam-users
add rbc-dam-admins to group dam-users

create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/shared/brand
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/shared/documents
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/cards/product-images
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/cards/promotional
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/cards/documents
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/gic/benefits
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/gic/tools
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo/gic/documents

set ACL for rbc-dam-authors
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:versionManagement on /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo
end

set ACL for rbc-dam-reviewers
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:versionManagement,crx:replicate on /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo
end

set ACL for rbc-dam-admins
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write,jcr:versionManagement,crx:replicate,jcr:readAccessControl,jcr:modifyAccessControl on /content/dam/rbc-eds-demo
end
